detail.body:
Add four extension points for custom MLA arithmetic and DSA metadata while retaining the SRT forward lifecycle: `run_mla_indexer`, `prepare_mla_qkv`, `project_mla_values`, and `init_kernel_metadata`.

Defaults preserve existing operations and fast paths. Query-transforming overrides set `needs_unfused_mla_qkv = True` to receive materialized queries. Custom indexers run during CP prefill; custom metadata refreshes on replay and opts out of glue capture. LoRA correction, output gating/projection, shared-index reuse, and seed handoff remain in the existing lifecycle.

**Scope:** ROCm dense MHA preparation dispatches the indexer hook. The separate `MLA_ROCM` absorbed path bypasses the arithmetic hooks and requires its own overrides.

### Validation

- **41 CPU tests and 10 subtests passed** after merging main at `af98fcd545` (merge commit `8baffc66f3`), across metadata replay/glue and shared-index coverage. Removed the mocked arithmetic-hook matrix; retained compact regressions for live custom metadata and allocation-free default replay.
- Real DSA backend tests on GB300: **4 tests and 18 subtests passed**, four unsupported variants skipped. Local runtime used a version override. The [targeted H100 SM90 seed-handoff regression](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41483435675/job/125407686007) subsequently passed on `6cef97f7c3` (one test executed, not skipped).
- [Earlier B300 CI](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40026484048/job/120979490748) passed GLM-5.2 GSM8K at **0.94072** against **0.935** on retry.
- The [eight-GPU CP failure](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41483265706/job/125408674764) matches the separate [upstream diagnostic](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47980#issuecomment-6590420271): maximum VERIFY/prefill logprob gap 0.8945 on CP8, with plain TP8 also exceeding the 0.02 bound (0.4381). Merged main includes the CI disablement from [#47894](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47894); [#47970](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47970) proposes measured replacement bounds. This PR adds no tolerance change. Fresh CI is pending; no dedicated throughput benchmark.

```bash
python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_dsa_kernel_metadata_hook.py \
  test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_index_topk_share.py \
  test/registered/unit/model_executor/runner/test_dsv41_draft_metadata_glue.py \
  test/registered/unit/model_executor/runner/test_dsv41_target_verify_metadata_glue.py
```

+"""Custom metadata must stay fresh without adding work to default DSA replay."""
+
+import sys
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention import dsa_backend
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+DSA = dsa_backend.DeepseekSparseAttnBackend
+
+
+def test_default_multistep_replay_does_not_allocate_hook_batch(monkeypatch):
+    """Default DSA replay must not allocate a batch view for empty hooks."""
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor import forward_batch_info
+
+    backend = dsa_backend.DeepseekSparseAttnMultiStepBackend.__new__(
+        dsa_backend.DeepseekSparseAttnMultiStepBackend
+    )
+    backend.speculative_num_steps = 3
+    backend.attn_backends = [DSA.__new__(DSA), DSA.__new__(DSA)]
+    refreshed = []
+    backend._init_forward_metadata_replay = refreshed.append
+
+    def unexpected_view(*args, **kwargs):
+        pytest.fail("default replay allocated a hook batch view")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(forward_batch_info, "build_inner_fb_view", unexpected_view)
+    batch = SimpleNamespace(batch_size=2)
+    backend.init_forward_metadata_out_graph(batch)
+    assert refreshed == [batch]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("multistep", [False, True])
+def test_custom_metadata_is_never_frozen_in_glue_graph(multistep):
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.metadata_glue_graph import MetadataGlueGraph
+
+    class CustomDSA(DSA):
+        def init_kernel_metadata(self, batch):
+            self.observed.append(list(batch.requests))
+
+        def init_forward_metadata_out_graph(self, batch):
+            self.init_kernel_metadata(batch)
+
+    child = CustomDSA.__new__(CustomDSA)
+    child.observed = []
+    backend = (
+        SimpleNamespace(
+            requires_eager_metadata=False,
+            attn_backend_list=[child],
+            init_forward_metadata_out_graph=child.init_forward_metadata_out_graph,
+        )
+        if multistep
+        else child
+    )
+    glue = MetadataGlueGraph("cpu")
+    for requests in ([2, 0], [1, 3], [3, 2], [0, 1]):
+        glue.run(backend, SimpleNamespace(requests=requests), (2,))
+    assert child.observed == [[2, 0], [1, 3], [3, 2], [0, 1]]
+    assert glue.disabled
+    assert not glue.is_captured((2,))
+    assert not DSA.__new__(DSA).requires_eager_metadata
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Materialize the absorbed query before invoking its hook**

When `_can_fuse_bmm_into_attention()` is true on the default DSA graph-split surface, `q_nope_out` here is only the `new_empty` view created by `_make_mla_bmm_fusion_plan`; the absorbed BMM does not run until `forward_absorb_core`. An override that performs the advertised arithmetic on `q` therefore reads uninitialized memory, while an in-place transformation is overwritten by the later BMM, producing incorrect attention. Disable this fusion when the preparation hook is overridden or materialize the BMM before invoking the hook.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

#### 1. 🔴 Blocking: DSA MTP seed-handoff MHA subtest fails with TypeError: this PR removed layer_id but left kit caller passing it
`python/sglang/srt/models/deepseek_common/attention_forward_methods/forward_mha.py:96`

`forward_dsa_indexer_for_mha` dropped the `layer_id` keyword (and changed its first param to a `run_indexer` callable), but the test kit `python/sglang/test/kits/attention_unittest/attention_methods/dsa_attention.py:1516` (`run_dsa_mtp_seed_handoff_case`) still passes `layer_id=0`. Registered test `test/registered/attention/unittests/dsa/test_dsa.py:435` reaches this and fails with `TypeError: forward_dsa_indexer_for_mha() got an unexpected keyword argument 'layer_id'`. Production callers and `test_index_topk_share.py` were updated but the kit was not. Drop `layer_id=0` from the kit call; optionally type-hint `run_indexer`.

**How it is reached:** pr-test.yml base-b-test-1-gpu-large (runs_on 1-gpu-h100, SM90) -> test/registered/attention/unittests/dsa/test_dsa.py::test_mtp_seed_handoff_cases (seed_path='mha') -> run_dsa_mtp_seed_handoff_case -> dsa_attention.py:1516 forward_dsa_indexer_for_mha(..., layer_id=0) -> TypeError against the new signature at forward_mha.py:96

**Who is affected:** Every PR CI run on the 1-gpu-large (H100, SM90) runner fails the registered DSA MTP seed-handoff test; production model forward is unaffected because the PR updated both runtime callers.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

#### 2. 🟠 Should fix: New hook/glue unit tests use mock stand-ins, breaking on refactors and only indirectly covering the default capture route
`test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_dsa_kernel_metadata_hook.py:230-258`

The new tests in `test_dsa_kernel_metadata_hook.py` build backends from `SimpleNamespace`/`__new__` stand-ins wired to private methods (`_apply_cuda_graph_metadata`, `_precompute_replay_metadata`, `_copy_replay_metadata_from_sibling`). They will break on internal renames rather than on behaviour changes. `test_custom_metadata_is_never_frozen_in_glue_graph` does check that the eager short-circuit is taken: without it, the third `run` would reach `torch.cuda.Stream()` on CPU. Only its final `not glue.is_captured((2,))` assertion follows trivially from `glue.disabled`. The default direction is covered only in pieces: the test asserts `not DSA.__new__(DSA).requires_eager_metadata`, and `TestGlueCaptureFailure` routes a `requires_eager_metadata=False` mock to capture. An end-to-end check with a real default DSA backend would be a cheap addition.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers refactoring DSA metadata internals; no runtime user impact.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

#### 3. 🟠 Should fix: Multistep draft-decode replay adds ~3 µs host overhead by building inner_fb and looping hooks unconditionally
`python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/dsa_backend.py:4359`

`DeepseekSparseAttnMultiStepBackend.init_forward_metadata_out_graph` now calls `build_inner_fb_view` (a fresh `SimpleNamespace`) on every replay, not only under `in_capture`. On the stock backend it then calls the no-op `init_kernel_metadata` on each of the `speculative_num_steps - 1` children. The added host cost is a few microseconds per draft-decode replay, small next to `_init_forward_metadata_replay`. Consider building the view and running the loop only when some child's `requires_eager_metadata` is true.

**Who is affected:** DSA models (DeepSeek-V3.2/GLM-5) running multi-step speculative draft decode with CUDA graphs.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#8616](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/8616) on `python/sglang/srt/models/deepseek_v2.py`, [#25001](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/25001) on `python/sglang/srt/models/deepseek_common/attention_forward_methods/forward_mla.py`, [#40782](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40782) on `python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/dsa_backend.py`

Fixed the stale MHA seed-handoff kit caller in a764c807d5 by removing the obsolete layer_id keyword. The hook, metadata-glue, and seed-export CPU suites pass 112 tests and 10 subtests. The registered seed-handoff cases skip on local GB300 because they require SM90; H100 CI must validate them. Updated the description.

The new MLA extension hooks are only wired into the CUDA absorbed path and the MHA paths. `DeepseekMLARocmForwardMixin.forward_absorb_rocm_prepare` still calls `self.indexer(...)` directly (`forward_mla_rocm.py:663`, `:690`) and `self.rotary_emb` (`:816`). `forward_absorb_rocm_core` still uses `rocm_absorb_v_bmm` (`:1122`), and the ROCm path never checks `needs_unfused_mla_qkv`. On HIP, DSA/MLA dispatch is remapped MLA -> MLA_ROCM, so a subclass overriding `run_mla_indexer`, `prepare_mla_qkv` or `project_mla_values` would be silently ignored there. No in-tree class overrides these hooks today; either route the ROCm mixin through them or document that they are CUDA-path only.

**Who is affected:** Only a future or out-of-tree DeepseekV2AttentionMLA subclass that overrides the new hooks and runs on ROCm/HIP with the absorbed MLA path.
